import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;
    static long n;
    static List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[10];
    static long[] sum = new long[10];
    static long cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0, ans = 0;
    static int[] pw = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer st;

    static long readInput() throws IOException {
        long result = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        int ch;
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1) break;
            if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') break;
            if (ch == '-') sign = -1;
        }
        do {
            result = (result << 1) + (result << 3) + (ch - '0');
            ch = br.read();
        } while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9');
        return result * sign;
    }

    static boolean check(long x) {
        return x * 1000000L + 999999L <= n && x * 10000000L > n;
    }

    static void dfs1(int len, long val) {
        if (len > 6) return;
        v[len].add((int)((cnt1 - val + MOD1) % MOD1));
        sum[len] += (cnt1 - val + MOD1) % MOD1;
        ++cnt1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; ++i) {
            dfs1(len + 1, val * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int len, long val) {
        if (val > n) return;
        if (check(val)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
                long v1 = ((cnt2 + 1 - val * pw[i]) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
                int num = lowerBound(v[i], (int)(MOD1 - v1));
                ans = (ans + (sum[i] + v[i].size() * v1 - 1L * MOD1 * (v[i].size() - num))) % MOD2;
            }
            cnt2 += cnt1;
        } else {
            if (len != 0) ++cnt2;
            ans = (ans + ((cnt2 - val) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
            for (int i = (! (len != 0) ? 0 : 1); i <= 9; ++i) {
                dfs2(len + 1, val * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        n = readInput();
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }
        dfs2(0, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
